verificationSummary: The browser-only React/Vite workspace uses strict gateway.v1/gateway.v2 clients, a durable SSE synchronizer and browser storage limited to unsent Thread drafts, display density and the last cursor.

The authenticated UI covers Thread list and chat, streaming Run events, cancellation, approvals, durable tasks and repository monitor, inbox, Memory correction/delete, Trace, sessions/devices and healthy/degraded state.

Every mutation creates an idempotency key and renders pending, accepted, replayed, rejected or expired status; private draft and Memory correction text first pass through the protected Payload admission route.

The repeatable real-browser script performs actual clicks and text entry for message submission, Run cancellation, approval, task pause, Memory correction/delete and session revocation, then validates health degradation and SSE recovery.

Semantic landmarks, labels, live regions, visible focus, non-color connection text, contrast, minimum touch target and axe automation establish the intended baseline without claiming complete WCAG 2.2 AA or trilingual acceptance.
unverified: The browser fixture returns strict contract-shaped deterministic snapshots; it is not a real public identity, production Control Plane, persisted read model or Cloudflare path.

Firefox could not launch because the installed Playwright binary was blocked by its macOS content sandbox; full Safari, Chrome, Edge, Firefox, iOS Safari and Android Chrome version coverage remains Task 27.
Complete trilingual UX and WCAG 2.2 AA remain governed by the dedicated Control Center experience Spec.
externalEffects: Qualification used only a temporary 127.0.0.1 fixture and local browser processes and left no accepted product command outside the fixture process.
No user browser profile, browser account, external service, production state or public endpoint was changed.
